messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: PROD-GPU-CAPACITY - autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes on prod-gpu cluster. Queue growth > 5k requests, token throttling observed. Paging on-call: @sara-nguyen :rotating_light:

sara-nguyen: taking pager. Confirming impact — dashboards show inference queue spike and increased 429/503s from router. Triage in progress. Anyone seeing relevant autoscaler/AWS errors?

mike-cho: seeing repeated scaleup attempts from cluster-autoscaler but ASG API returns errors. Relevant excerpt from autoscaler log: ```2026-03-15T10:12:03Z cluster-autoscaler: ScaleUp failed: launch template version mismatch: LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcde, Version=1 -> InvalidLaunchTemplateVersion.NotFound``` Also a later error: ```Error attaching instance: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation```.

anjali-roy: pods pending with message `0/4 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match node selector, 4 NoSchedule taints`. Looks like new nodes aren't being created or have wrong launch template that doesn't include GPU AMI label. `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide` shows inference pods pending due to `NoSchedule` taint.

kevin-lin: CloudTrail shows autoscaling attempted to create instances but the launch template version referenced by ASG is deprecated. Also see `iam:PassRole` denied for the autoscaler role when creating instance profile: ```AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2InstanceProfileRole```

sara-nguyen: ok root cause hypothesis — ASG/launch-template drift + insufficient autoscaler IAM perms. Impact: customer requests slowed, rate-limiters kicking in, a few enterprise customers reported degraded inference latency. Routing plan? We should enable fallback to dedicated pool to reduce customer impact while we restore capacity.

mike-cho: I can create a temporary nodegroup with the correct LT version and GPU AMI to relieve queue. Will also bump ASG max nodes from 30 -> 50 for the interim. Command I'll run: ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name prod-gpu-asg --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcde,Version=4 --max-size 50```

anjali-roy: on the schedule/tolerations side, we can patch deployments to tolerate the gpu taint so they land on the new nodes once they come up: ```kubectl -n prod patch deployment inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations","value":[{"key":"gpu","operator":"Equal","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}]'```

infra-sre-bot: infra action: created temporary nodegroup `ng-temp-187650` with instance-type g4dn.xlarge, launch-template-version 4. Nodegroup status: CREATING.

sara-nguyen: also changing cluster-autoscaler config to allow using older LT versions temporarily and increase scaleup retries. Adding `--balance-similar-node-groups=false` for immediate relief.

mike-cho: manual ASG update applied, and I triggered a scale up to desired capacity +10. Logs now show instances launching. Example from EC2: ```Instance i-0f1a2b3c reached RUNNING, attached to ASG prod-gpu-asg```

infra-sre-bot: node `ip-10-0-45-67` registered to cluster (ng-temp-187650). kubelet labels: `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=g4dn.xlarge`, `redwood/gpu=true`.

anjali-roy: pods are starting to schedule onto new nodes. Pending count dropping from ~1200 -> 300 in 6 minutes. Queue length steadying.

sara-nguyen: started customer comms: posted status update to status.redwood.ai and emailed impacted enterprise contacts with mitigation plan + ETA for full restore.

kevin-lin: double-checked IAM — autoscaler role missing `iam:PassRole`. I updated policy to include: ```{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["iam:PassRole"],"Resource":["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2InstanceProfileRole"]}``` Will monitor for any further AccessDenied.

mike-cho: temporary measures in place: ng-temp up and pods scheduling. I'm watching token throughput; latency back within SLO for most customers. Still seeing occasional throttle for a small shard.

infra-sre-bot: Nodegroup `ng-temp-187650` status: RUNNING. 8 nodes registered.

sara-nguyen: moving to incident handoff — I'll keep this as a high-priority incident but lowering the pager to watch-only in 30m if stabilization continues. Action items assigned: 1) infra: add automated LT version drift detector (kevin-lin), 2) security: ensure autoscaler role has iam:PassRole (kevin-lin, done), 3) platform: add alert for ASG/launch-template errors in cluster-autoscaler logs (mike-cho), 4) devex: create runbook for temporary nodegroup creation and toleration patch (anjali-roy).

kevin-lin: noted — will open PR for LT checker and a short policy change doc.

mike-cho: I'll follow up with post-incident remediation steps in the infra backlog and schedule a runbook review.

anjali-roy: small reminder — we should add a canary that verifies new LT versions include correct GPU AMI label to avoid this next time.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: PROD-GPU-CAPACITY - mitigated. Queue decreasing, nodes added. Pager reduced to watch-only. Please continue updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:

sara-nguyen: handing off to oncall next shift at 2026-03-15T11:10Z. I'll include remediation notes in the incident tracker. Good work team. :pray:

mike-cho: quick postmortem summary to paste into tracker: "Root cause: launch template version drift referenced by ASG + missing iam:PassRole for autoscaler caused scale-up failures. Immediate mitigation: created temporary nodegroup with correct LT, patched deployments tolerations, bumped ASG max size. Recovery: pods scheduled to new nodes, queue back to acceptable levels. Follow-ups: LT drift detector, autoscaler policy fix, alerting for autoscaler LT errors, runbook."

infra-sre-bot: Incident closed for paging. Watch-only until 1876508667.
